{"description":"Priority: P0 | Area: plugins | Labels: chore,area:plugin,P0 | Milestone: v0.1.0 | RFC: none (registry OQ to be recorded in bitty-plugins-docs) | Task: CTX-0001

Bootstrap the new public repository bitty-terminal/bitty-plugins: official plugin directory, registry, store frontend, and official plugin aggregation repo.

Deliverables:
- baseline scaffold: AGENTS/CONTRIBUTING/SECURITY/CHANGELOG/TODO, justfile gates, lefthook, commitlint, markdownlint, CarryCtx baseline, issue/PR templates, dependabot (no npm updater)
- registry/schema.json (future kinds allowed), registry/official/activity.toml, registry/community/.gitkeep
- scripts: validate-registry.ts, generate-index.ts, sync-metadata.ts (bun + TypeScript only)
- generated/registry.json (schema_version, generated_at, plugins[] with official flag)

- submodules (HTTPS): sdk/ -> bitty-plugin-sdk, template/ -> bitty-plugin-template, plugins/activity/ -> activity
- CI: registry-check.yml (validate + regenerate + stale diff), plugin-integration.yml (full gates + submodule smoke), deploy.yml (workflow_dispatch, dormant until Cloudflare provisioning), codeql.yml
- gates: just check, actionlint, act -n, gitleaks, recurse-submodule clone verification

{"description":"Priority: P2 | Area: plugins | Labels: chore,area:plugins,P2 | Milestone: v0.1.0 | RFC: OQ-053 | Task: CTX-0005

Follow-up recorded by bitty CTX-0426 (official plugin onboarding policy): no current gate proves that a plugins/<name> submodule pin is a commit reachable from the plugin repository mainline (default branch), even though the policy requires it. scripts/validate-registry.ts checks entry schema, duplicate ids, repository URL existence, license, and compatibility syntax only; registry-check only detects a stale generated/registry.json.

Scope: add a bounded reachability check (for example git ls-remote plus an ancestry check, or the GitHub compare API) that fails when an official plugin submodule pin is not an ancestor of the plugin default branch; degrade gracefully offline with a notice, consistent with the existing network guard.

Acceptance: runs through the justfile only, covered by tests/registry.test.ts including an offline path; existing palette/statusline/activity pins pass; policy and README maintainer steps updated if the gate changes them.","displayId":"CTX-0005","id":"01M2F9WR1C5SQ7VQBP7CY4BJ6V","priority":"normal","status":"ready","title":"chore(registry): validate official plugin submodule pins are mainline commits"}

{"description":"Priority: P2 | Area: plugins | Labels: chore,area:plugins,P2 | Milestone: v0.1.0 | RFC: OQ-053 | Task: CTX-0006

Follow-up recorded by bitty CTX-0426 (official plugin onboarding policy): checkLocalManifests in scripts/validate-registry.ts silently skips an official entry when plugins/<name>/bitty-plugin.toml is missing, and nothing checks that the .gitmodules URL for plugins/<name> matches the entry repository field. An official entry can therefore exist with no pinned submodule, or with a mismatched URL.

Scope: static offline checks that (1) every registry/official/<name>.toml has a plugins/<name> submodule declared in .gitmodules, (2) the submodule URL matches the entry repository field, and (3) plugins/<name> directories with no official entry are reported; keep diagnostic severities consistent with existing output.

Acceptance: covered by tests/registry.test.ts; the existing three official entries pass; just registry-validate and just check green; policy and README maintainer steps updated if the gate changes them.","displayId":"CTX-0006","id":"01M2F9WY590R4V301RWS6GM9ZZ","priority":"normal","status":"ready","title":"chore(registry): require a plugins/<name> submodule for every official entry"}
